messages.text: On 2026-07-22 I ordered a Batch 3 unit. It was scheduled to ship on 2026-09-30. When will it ship?
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Looked something up in Shopify
Used the store-orders skill

Your B30 on the July 22 order now ships November 7, 2026. The two Power K.s go out in the same box.

Nothing has left the warehouse yet, so the tracking mail will come to the address on the order when it does. Sorry it slipped past the original date. Anything else you want me to check on it?
The HeliumDeploy web site says that Batch 3 ships 2026-10-14.
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The Oct 14 you're seeing is the batch currently on sale, not the unit on your order. Yours is from the earlier B30 book, and the date now on it is November 7.

The B30 run is still being built at the factory, so nothing is at the warehouse yet. When it lands, yours ships with both Power K.s in one box and tracking goes to the email on the order.

Happy to look again if anything moves.
What are the Power K.s that you mention?
Read the power kit page
Looked something up in Shopify

They're free add-ons we put on B30 orders. A plug-in energy monitor that sits between the wall and the miner and shows watts, kWh and what it's costing you, once you enter your power rate.

You have two on the order, one with a US cable and one with an EU cable. For New Zealand the EU one is the usable one, with a socket adapter. Both are $0, and they ride in the box with the B30.
That's nice, when were the energy monitors included? They weren't part of it when I bought it.
Looked something up in Shopify

We added them in mid September, Mark, with the B30 update that went out on the 15th. A free Power K. for everyone waiting, price locked. The second one went on two days later so you'd have the right cable for your address.

That update is also where the first week of November came from. It went to the email on the order, so worth a look in spam if you missed it.
Thanks - the email went into Spam. I have found it, you are very helpful!
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what made the B30 the one you picked, over the other miners you were weighing?
Efficiency (BM1373 chip), and the box-style packaging with integrated PSU is perfect.
Was the integrated PSU about noise and heat where it sits, or just wanting one tidy box instead of loose parts?
One tidy box. Also, I appreciate them working on making it quieter.
Where's it going to live once it lands, somewhere you'll hear it, like an office or living room, or tucked out of the way?
It will go in my office. So quietness is key.

That's useful, thank you Mark. The cooling redesign is exactly why batch 1 took longer, so an office is the right test of it.

I was very happy to help. If you were pleased with how this went, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You're also welcome in our Discord for build chat and drop news: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Thanks! Will you give my feedback to the developers? I'm happy to wait a little longer for a quieter unit, and of course the main thing is that it will run 24x7 reliably for many years.
Handed to the team · customer feedback for the product team, passing it on

Yes, I've passed it to the team, word for word: the office placement, the quiet, and that reliability over years is what you're really buying. That kind of note from an actual buyer carries weight with the Harlo side.

Nothing for you to wait on. Your B30 ships November 7 and tracking goes to your Gmail, now that you've pulled us out of spam.
Thank you Sarah, I take it you are an AI?

I am, yes. I'm the team's automated first line, and a real person steps in whenever something needs one.

Abel and Georges are back at 10am Eastern if you ever want a human on it. Otherwise you're set, Mark, and a copy of this whole chat comes to your email once we're done here.
OK great, you were very helpful. I'm looking forward to getting the B30!

Enjoy it when it lands, Mark. Set the Power K. up first and you'll see exactly what it draws in your office from day one.

Anything else comes up before November, just open the chat.
